consumer_fields.note: Field ids inferred from 00_intention_contract.json evaluation_unit, row_expectations, and required_output_shape; roles supplying these ids must declare semantic_identity.

limitations: Consumer field ids are not enumerated as a dedicated block in 00_intention_contract.json; bindings follow evaluation_unit and row_expectations language.

Permit PDF semantic extraction vocabulary is declared but C0–C1 PDF compilation is not yet available from prior passes; permit_stated_condition tuples may be absent until a later pass ingests sources/permit_files.

Closed-world negation for affirmative not-required outcomes is not representable as persistent World negation; Purpose B not-required and Purpose C classifications rely on positive evidence or UNRESOLVED.

relations.name: in_scope_facility
relations.meaning: A selected NPDES facility permit number within the Federal FY2025 diligence universe.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to sources/source_manifest.json facilities list and 00_intention_contract.json universe_scope.facilities.
relations.construction_rule: Emit one tuple per permit in universe_scope.facilities; referent id stable from permit number (e.g. npdes:NM0020583).

relations.name: reported_dmr_measurement
relations.meaning: A DMR-reported measurement row as recorded in structured source data, including value, unit, qualifier, statistical basis, monitoring period end, and optional NODI code.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to sources/structured/dmr_measurements.csv by DMR_EVENT_ID and DMR_VALUE_ID (or DMR_FORM_VALUE_ID when value id absent).
relations.construction_rule: Parse CSV; one referent per distinct measurement row; copy fields verbatim without compliance interpretation.

relations.name: permit_limit_schedule_row
relations.meaning: A permit limit schedule value row with numeric limit metadata, type codes, effective dates, frequency, and optional monitoring flag as compiled from structured permit limit tables.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to sources/structured/permit_limits.csv by LIMIT_ID and LIMIT_VALUE_ID.
relations.construction_rule: Parse CSV; one referent per limit value row; preserve LIMIT_TYPE_CODE and OPTIONAL_MONITORING_FLAG as source-recorded signals without purpose classification.

relations.name: permit_limit_active_month
relations.meaning: Whether a permit limit schedule row is active in a given calendar month according to compiled month flags from structured limit data.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to the corresponding JAN–DEC column (or ALL_MONTHS_LIMIT) on the source permit_limits.csv row.
relations.construction_rule: Explode month columns Y/N into one tuple per month per limit_row referent.

relations.name: fy2025_in_scope_measurement
relations.meaning: A reported DMR measurement whose monitoring period end falls within Federal FY2025 for an in-scope facility.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation receipt over reported_dmr_measurement with universe fy2025_in_scope_measurement; inputs grounded to source CSV rows.
relations.construction_rule: SQL filter: join in_scope_facility on permit_nbr; MONITORING_PERIOD_END_DATE between 2024-10-01 and 2025-09-30 inclusive.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One output tuple per reported_dmr_measurement satisfying date and facility scope.

relations.name: measurement_limit_candidate_join
relations.meaning: A mechanical correspondence linking a reported measurement to a permit limit schedule row by shared permit, discharge feature, parameter, and overlapping effective/period dates.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation over reported_dmr_measurement and permit_limit_schedule_row; join_basis cites matching key fields and date overlap logic.
relations.construction_rule: SQL equijoin on permit_nbr, perm_feature_nbr, parameter_code; require monitoring_period_end within [limit_begin_date, limit_end_date]; optionally require permit_limit_active_month match for period month.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Cartesian filter via exact key equality and date overlap; zero-or-more limit_row candidates per measurement.

relations.name: monitoring_requirement_candidate
relations.meaning: A monitoring obligation candidate derived from compiled permit schedule metadata (frequency, parameter, location, optional flag) without deciding FY2025 applicability.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation over permit_limit_schedule_row for in-scope facilities; requirement referent derived from limit schedule identity.
relations.construction_rule: Project distinct schedule rows with non-empty LIMIT_FREQ_OF_ANALYSIS_CODE; set requirement_kind to standing_schedule unless DMR_COMMENT_TEXT signals event/study trigger (text preserved, not interpreted here).
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One requirement candidate per qualifying permit_limit_schedule_row intersecting FY2025 effective dates for in-scope facilities.

relations.name: no_ordinary_numeric_result_measurement
relations.meaning: An in-scope FY2025 monitoring expectation lacking an ordinary numeric reported result, including empty DMR values and NODI-coded rows.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation over fy2025_in_scope_measurement; expectation referent aliases measurement referent for DMR-anchored cases.
relations.construction_rule: Select fy2025 rows where DMR_VALUE_NMBR is null/empty or NODI_CODE is present; has_numeric_value false when no ordinary numeric result.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One tuple per qualifying measurement in Purpose C universe.

relations.name: permit_stated_condition
relations.meaning: Permit-source language stating a conditional monitoring or discharge trigger (e.g., when discharging, seasonal, event) independent of whether the condition held in FY2025.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground in permit_limits.csv DMR_COMMENT_TEXT and/or extracted permit PDF excerpts listed in source_manifest.json.
relations.construction_rule: Extract conditional phrases from structured comment fields mechanically; PDF excerpts require bounded text span identification with source path and page/section grounding.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Candidates from non-empty DMR_COMMENT_TEXT on schedule rows and permit PDF passages with explicit conditional language.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether source text states a discharge-, season-, event-, or study-conditioned monitoring trigger vs merely descriptive commentary.

relations.name: documented_no_discharge_assertion
relations.meaning: Source-documented claim that no discharge occurred for a facility feature within a stated period, as grounded in DMR NODI/permit/operator statements.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground in DMR NODI codes, DMR commentary, or permit/operator documentary statements with explicit no-discharge semantics.
relations.construction_rule: Identify tuples only when source material affirmatively documents no discharge for the period/context; do not infer from absent measurements alone.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Candidates from NODI-coded rows and permit/DMR text spans with explicit no-discharge language overlapping FY2025 periods.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether available evidence affirmatively documents no discharge vs merely reports a non-numeric absence.

relations.name: applicable_limit_selection
relations.meaning: Purpose A selection of at most one enforceable numeric limit candidate applicable to a measurement for compliance comparison, or an explicit unresolved disposition.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground in measurement_limit_candidate_join tuples plus permit schedule semantics; disposition UNRESOLVED when tie or insufficient evidence.
relations.construction_rule: Evaluate candidates per Purpose A applicability_selection policy; emit ACCEPT with one limit_row when uniquely established; otherwise UNRESOLVED without defaulting.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One judgment per fy2025_in_scope_measurement with at least one mechanical candidate or explicit zero-candidate unresolved case.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Which single enforceable numeric limit (if any) applies to the measurement for compliance comparison.

relations.name: limit_numeric_comparison_applicability
relations.meaning: Purpose A classification of whether a numeric compliance comparison is applicable, distinguishing enforceable numeric limits from report-only or non-comparable monitoring.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground in LIMIT_TYPE_CODE, OPTIONAL_MONITORING_FLAG, limit value presence, and Purpose A enforceable_numeric_limit / report_only_monitoring / no_numeric_comparison policies.
relations.construction_rule: Set comparison_class to enforceable_numeric, report_only, or no_numeric_comparison; comparison_applicable true only for enforceable_numeric; UNRESOLVED when classification indeterminate.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One judgment per applicable_limit_selection ACCEPT tuple and per measurement requiring classification when selection unresolved but candidates exist.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether monitoring is subject to enforceable numeric comparison vs report-only vs no numeric comparison applicable.

relations.name: exceedance_determination
relations.meaning: Purpose A determination whether a reported measurement exceeds the selected applicable limit after unit and statistical-base comparability checks.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground in reported_dmr_measurement and permit_limit_schedule_row values/units/qualifiers plus limit_numeric_comparison_applicability when comparison_applicable.
relations.construction_rule: Compare only when comparison_applicable and values are comparable under Purpose A exceedance_threshold policy; emit exceeds, within, not_evaluable, or UNRESOLVED.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One judgment per measurement/limit pair with comparison_applicable true.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether the measurement exceeds the applicable limit given qualifier semantics and unit/statistical-base alignment.

relations.name: monitoring_obligation_applicability
relations.meaning: Purpose B judgment whether a monitoring requirement was required, not required, or unresolved for FY2025 given schedule, season, and conditional trigger evidence.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground in monitoring_requirement_candidate, permit_limit_active_month, permit_stated_condition, and any discharge/event/study evidence; not_required requires affirmative non-applicability evidence.
relations.construction_rule: Three-valued logic: required, not_required, or UNRESOLVED; cite condition_evidence for conditional requirements; never infer not_required from missing DMR rows alone.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One judgment per monitoring_requirement_candidate overlapping FY2025 for in-scope facilities.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether monitoring was actually required in FY2025 for the requirement candidate.

relations.name: missing_evidence_classification
relations.meaning: Purpose C classification of what evidence establishes for a no-ordinary-numeric-result monitoring expectation, without inferring compliance or violation from absence alone.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground in no_ordinary_numeric_result_measurement, documented_no_discharge_assertion, monitoring_obligation_applicability context, and NODI/permit documentary evidence.
relations.construction_rule: Assign established_state among documented_no_discharge, conditional_not_required, other_documented_no_data, inadequate_evidence_for_required_monitoring, or UNRESOLVED per Purpose C policies.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Which Purpose C established state is supported by documentary evidence beyond mere missing numeric data.
